body:
Review-and-fix round 1: accepted=7, rejected=1, exonerated=7, neutral=2, rounds_completed=1.

Round 1 notable fixes: extended case-conversion and coproc patterns in lint-bash32.sh; fixed collect-agent-results.sh NS retry guard; fixed dispatch-code-voters.sh to store --diff-file/--plan-file values; improved launch-claude-review.sh diff context propagation; updated docs and sibling contracts.

Manually corrected review fix: broadened single-caret/comma case-conversion pattern introduced false positives on ${var//[^A-Z]/x} substitutions; refined to anchor on identifier boundary.

## Rejected Code Review Findings

### [Code Review] cursor-specialist-plan-fidelity-output.txt (FINDING_7)
**Finding**: Large unrelated collector retry, voter dispatch, Claude launcher role, and review harness changes bundled with Bash 3.2 lint work.
**Reason not implemented**: The review changes were accepted by the voter panel; changes to related scripts are small (< 30 LOC each) and address latent bugs discovered during review. The dispatch-code-voters.sh and launch-claude-review.sh changes are functionally isolated correctness fixes.
